"Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA): A contract that ensures confidential information shared between parties is not disclosed to unauthorized third parties."
"Settlement Agreement: A legal document that resolves a dispute between parties without admitting fault, usually involving compensation or corrective action."
"Employment Agreement: A legally binding contract that outlines the terms and conditions of employment, including job role, compensation, and termination clauses."
"Service Level Agreement (SLA): A contract between a service provider and client defining the expected level of service, performance metrics, and remedies for non-compliance."
"Partnership Agreement: A document that governs the relationship between two or more partners in a business, defining profit-sharing, responsibilities, and dispute resolution."
"Lease Agreement: A contract between a landlord and tenant granting the tenant the right to use property for a specified time in exchange for rent."
"Franchise Agreement: A contract that allows one party (franchisee) to use the brand, business model, and intellectual property of another party (franchisor) in exchange for fees or royalties."
"Sales Agreement: A legally binding contract between a buyer and seller that defines the terms of the sale of goods or services."
"Joint Venture Agreement: A contract between two or more parties to collaborate on a specific project while sharing profits, losses, and responsibilities."
"Loan Agreement: A contract between a lender and borrower specifying the loan amount, repayment schedule, interest rate, and default consequences."

Introduction 
Caregivers provide support to those in need, but their jobs often come with inherent risks. One of the 
way to improve trusts and safety of caregivers is empowering caregivers with safety tools. 
Empowering caregivers with safety tool is a critical component of building trust and protecting their 
wellbeing. Caregivers should be familiar with procedures for reporting and responding to safety 
concerns.

They encounters the safety concerns like incident of violence, threats on any situation that make them 
feel unsafe. Clear channel for reporting such concerns and ensuring reports need to be taken seriously 
and addressed promptly. This will enhance quality of care they provide. 
 
Caregiver current scenario 
Caregivers have been giving their services in various locations across the globe. Lately researchers have

been trying to track the current situation of the Caregivers. There has been a major outcry from the 
associated social community that caregivers are being victims of mental depression due to various 
factors like from physical abuse, improper working conditions, mental trauma, and heavy workload. 
 
Caregiver’s Need for solution 
Researcher is looking for a solution to address the global outcry of caregivers. Researchers want to

address the situation by providing the best effective solution. The solution will provide a mechanism for 
the caregivers to express their mental state and receive proper solution to help them come out of the 
situation. 
 
Proposed Solution 
By understanding the client problem and the scale of the situation, in the first phase of software 
development we have proposed the solution by means of the technology acting as the medium for

1. Web Portal 
Taking consideration to acknowledge and work on the vast field of mental health issues among the 
caregivers, who are working across the globe, a full featured Information System has been proposed.  
The Information System will be an online portal system which will be accessed by the caregiver, social 
parties, social workers, security parties, health professionals, doctors and researchers for various

purposes ranging from recording the caregiver issue in detail to providing mental health related 
guideline and eventually using the information base for knowledgebase creation.  
The Online based information system will provide the following modules 
1. Online Login/Registration Module 
2. Recording caregiver incident 
3. Knowledgebase and Analytics 
 
1. Online Login/Registration Module 
The Information portal can be accessed by all parties related with the mental health related field, the

concerned party or individual can register in to the system using valid information and can login in to the 
system based on the role provided.
